editorial.marketOverview: Friday afternoon selling intensified sharply. StockTitan's 15:02 EST readings put QQQ down 4.63%, Nvidia down 11.71%, SPY down 2.91% and DIA down 1.34%. These intraday observations show worsening technology liquidation and broad-market spillover, but are not closing prints. Earlier Reuters SOX -8.6% and European technology -5.4% are older cross-market observations, not synchronized.
editorial.whatChanged: Relative to the previous 14:49 EST assessment based on older Nasdaq -3.3% and SOX -8.6% readings, new 15:02 EST evidence shows QQQ losses accelerating from -3.87% at 13:01 to -4.63%, with Nvidia down 11.71%. This materially worsens the anticipated near-term path without changing its bearish directional label. Open Watch still contains 174 events and no new independent catalyst.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The price action is consistent with accelerating technology deleveraging and risk aversion extending to SPY and DIA. It does not prove any particular catalyst caused the decline. Previously reported 10Y and 2Y yields imply +29 bp but are stale and unsynchronized; earlier VIX 30.93 and Brent/WTI prices are stale. Direct FedWatch, VXN and breadth remain unverified.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday's close now carries greater downside-continuation significance. If QQQ and semiconductor leaders finish near their lows, Monday may open under additional selling pressure. A sharp oversold rebound is possible, but Tuesday durability depends on synchronized chip leadership, breadth improvement and volatility retreat. Precise targets cannot be justified from available data.
editorial.bullCase: A credible rebound requires simultaneous QQQ and SOX/SMH recovery, better breadth and declining VXN/VIX. Relative DIA resilience and earlier inflation-expectations relief are potential offsets, not confirmed reversal signals.
editorial.bearCase: QQQ -4.63%, Nvidia -11.71% and SPY -2.91% by 15:02 EST show both semiconductor stress and broadening liquidation. A near-low Friday close would increase downside follow-through risk for Monday and possibly Tuesday.
editorial.watchNext: Verify Friday official closes and aligned QQQ/SOX/SMH, breadth and VXN/VIX; track Monday open and Tuesday follow-through.
